definitions.gloss: match; competition; playing against; facing off
definitions.explanation: A competitive encounter between two opponents or teams. Used in sports, games, and any head-to-head competition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{対戦|たいせん}⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
⟦オンライン→オンライン：05278_onrain⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{対戦|たいせん}⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can compete against people from around the world online.

examples.japanese: ⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{二回|にかい}→二回：27625_nikai⟧{対戦|たいせん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧⟦{当|あ}たった→当たる：01860_ataru⟧。
examples.english: We were matched again with the team we played twice at last year's tournament.

notes:
USAGE:
Very common in sports reporting, video game culture, and competitive contexts. Used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to mean "to compete against."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {対戦|たいせん}⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧ (opponent)
- {対戦|たいせん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to compete against, to play against)
- {対戦|たいせん}⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧ (head-to-head record)
- {対戦|たいせん}⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧ (competitive game, versus game)

DISTINCTION FROM HOMOPHONE:
{対戦|たいせん} (match, competition) vs. ⟦{大戦|たいせん}→大戦：03771_taisen⟧ (great war, world war). The kanji differ: ⟦{対|たい}→対：03382_tai⟧ (versus) vs. {大|たい} (great).
